issues.issue: Budget schedule left out of detail entirely. The rules say to record a budget schedule's lines for every fund that has no more detailed schedule, including utility funds. The Utility fund (78,894 actual, 85,000 budget) has no other detail schedule. The governmental function lines duplicate p9 and can be left out. Note that the printed Sales Tax 23,446 differs from 23,374 on the statement (p4).
The function is set to 'other'. The listed-by-object rule calls for the fund's function (General Fund -> general government) plus review 'listed by object'.

issues.issue: beginning_cash and ending_cash are the modified-cash fund balances (212,959 -> 118,286), not cash. Governmental cash is 157,005, offset by a 37,673 interfund payable to the utility fund. The roll-forward is defensible but cash is overstated as labelled. It is marked computed and explained in notes.
Sales tax collected and owed to the state would fit better as 'due to other governments'.
